title: Dabo and Pepper Schnitzel
description: A German-inspired schnitzel recipe combining the flavors of exotic spices with dabo and pepper.
instructions: Cut the dabo into thin cutlets.
In a shallow dish, mix together flour, salt, and black pepper.
In another shallow dish, beat the eggs.
In a third dish, mix together breadcrumbs and exotic spices.
Dip each dabo cutlet in the flour mixture, coating both sides, then in the eggs, and finally in the breadcrumb mixture, pressing the crumbs onto the meat to adhere.
Heat about 1/2 inch of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
When the oil is hot, add 2-3 dabo cutlets to the skillet and fry until golden brown and cooked through, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Transfer the cooked schnitzel to a paper towel-lined plate to drain any excess oil.
Repeat with the remaining dabo cutlets.
Serve the schnitzel hot with your favorite sides, such as lemon wedges, coleslaw, or braised red cabbage.
